# codigate_app_edge_rules (Resource)

All edge rules of one app: IP and country lists, path rules, rate limit, automatic bans, the browser challenge and the WAF. This resource owns the app's complete rule set: anything not in the configuration is cleared, and destroying it clears all rules. Country lists, rate limit, ban, challenge and WAF need a paid plan; on Free they are stored but listed in inactive. Import by app id or hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codigate_app_edge_rules" "wiki" {
  app_id          = codigate_app.wiki.id
  allow_countries = ["NL", "BE"]
  deny_ips        = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
  path_rules = [
    { path = "/admin", action = "login" },
    { path = "/.git", action = "block" },
  ]
  rate_limit_per_minute = 600
  ban = {
    after_rate_limits = 3
    window_seconds    = 600
    duration_seconds  = 3600
  }
  challenge = {
    mode            = "auto"
    auto_per_minute = 120
  }
  waf = {
    mode       = "block"
    exclusions = [942100]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Id of the app.

### Optional

- `allow_countries` (Set of String) Only visitors from these countries (uppercase ISO codes) may connect. Paid plans.
- `allow_ips` (Set of String) Only these IP addresses or CIDR ranges may connect (canonical form, at most 100).
- `ban` (Attributes) Ban an IP address for a while after repeated rate limits or failed sign-ins. Paid plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ban))
- `challenge` (Attributes) Browser challenge (proof of work) before the app. Paid plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--challenge))
- `deny_countries` (Set of String) Visitors from these countries are refused. Paid plans.
- `deny_ips` (Set of String) These IP addresses or CIDR ranges are refused (canonical form, at most 100).
- `path_rules` (Attributes List) Per-path actions, checked in order (at most 50). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--path_rules))
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Requests per minute per IP address (1-100000). Paid plans.
- `waf` (Attributes) Web application firewall (OWASP CRS). Leave out to turn it off. Paid plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--waf))

### Read-Only

- `advanced_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the workspace plan enforces the paid parts.
- `id` (String) Same as app_id.
- `inactive` (List of String) Stored parts the edge does not enforce on the current plan.

<a id="nestedatt--ban"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ban`

Required:

- `duration_seconds` (Number) Ban length in seconds (1-86400).
- `window_seconds` (Number) Counting window in seconds (1-3600).

Optional:

- `after_failed_logins` (Number) Ban after this many failed sign-ins within the window (0 = off).
- `after_rate_limits` (Number) Ban after this many rate-limited requests within the window (0 = off).


<a id="nestedatt--challenge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `challenge`

Required:

- `mode` (String) on (always) or auto (when an IP sends more than auto_per_minute requests).

Optional:

- `auto_per_minute` (Number) Requests per minute that turn the challenge on (mode auto only, 10-1000000).
- `cookie_minutes` (Number) How long a solved challenge lasts (5-1440 minutes). Defaults to 30.
- `difficulty` (String) low, medium or high. Defaults to medium.


<a id="nestedatt--path_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `path_rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) block (refuse) or login (always require sign-in, also for public apps).
- `path` (String) Path prefix, lowercase, starting with / (not / itself).


<a id="nestedatt--waf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `waf`

Required:

- `mode` (String) detect (log only) or block.

Optional:

- `exclusions` (Set of Number) CRS rule ids to skip, for example 942100 (at most 100).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By app id or hostname.
terraform import codigate_app_edge_rules.wiki wiki.example.com
```
